description.value:
Asari are born with the potential for biotic ability, arising from the unique interaction between their nervous system and element zero nodules accumulated before birth. Your biotic talent manifests as an innate command of mass effect fields.

You gain the ability to cast telekinetic projectile as an occult innate cantrip. Your spellcasting ability for this innate spell is Charisma. Unlike biotic powers developed later through training, this instinctual ability requires no focus and no formal schooling—it is simply part of what you are.

Note: Add the Telekinetic Projectile innate spell rule element (occult, at-will, cantrip, Charisma-based DC) via the Rules tab.

publication.title: Mass Effect Actor and Ancestry Compendium
